_description: STOP zones for the meta-log template. Used by check-agent-ingest-preservation.py to verify compression preserves the weekly-meta schema vocabulary, section structure, YAML manifest keys, pattern/issue/candidate ID system (P1/I1/C1), and the buds 2026-05-19 anchor-incident worked example.
verbatim_required: Layer 3 of the three-layer agent architecture
_verbatim_required_rationale: Section names + YAML manifest keys + status/severity enums + role-archetype slot + precondition vocabulary (research-complete et al.) that downstream meta sessions pattern-match on. The operator-decision-tier vocabulary classifies skill-edit candidates by review cost; preserved verbatim because the operator scans for these tier labels when deciding sign-off urgency.
_custom_id_patterns_rationale: P-prefix (Pattern), I-prefix (Issue), C-prefix (Candidate) IDs cross-reference each section's structured entries. Layer references anchor the three-layer agent architecture from SKILL.md.
_placeholder_required_rationale: Bracketed substitution slots the meta agent fills in when authoring or refreshing the meta log. Each must survive (count must not decrease).
_anchor_phrases_rationale: The annotated worked example anchors to a concrete buds week of 2026-05-19 with four named research-precondition agents (A-fdroid-research, B-license-edit, C-ip-protection-priorities, D-readme-strategy) and the FSL/f-droid pattern P1. Path references anchor cross-file navigation.
